name: LaunchExcel
label: Launch Excel Application
description: Launches a new Excel application instance or opens an existing Excel document.

fields.name: LaunchMode
fields.label: Launch Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to open an existing document or create a new one.

fields.name: DocumentPath
fields.label: Document Path
fields.description: The path to the Excel document to open. Required if 'Launch Mode' is 'Open Existing'.

fields.name: MakeInstanceVisible
fields.label: Make Instance Visible
fields.description: Determines whether the Excel application should be visible.

fields.name: OpenAsReadOnly
fields.label: Open as ReadOnly
fields.description: If true, opens the document in read-only mode.

fields.name: NestUnderNewProcess
fields.label: Nest Under New Process
fields.description: If true, launches Excel in a new process.

fields.name: UseMachineLocale
fields.label: Use Machine Locale
fields.description: If true, uses the machine's locale settings.

fields.name: ReadProtectionPassword
fields.label: Read Protection Password
fields.description: Optional password to protect the document from being modified.

fields.name: WriteProtectionPassword
fields.label: Write Protection Password
fields.description: Optional password to protect the document from being saved.

fields.name: ExcelInstance
fields.label: Excel Instance
fields.description: Returns the launched Excel Application object.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: Returns the active or newly created Workbook object.
